items.title: 2027 Vision Compass
items.alt: Navy 2027 Vision lettering inside a gold compass ring with four pointed markers and a curved upward arrow.
items.description: The clear year sits above the word Vision within the open center of the circular design.

items.title: 2027 Goals Planner
items.alt: Open navy spiral planner labeled 2027 Goals, with three empty checkbox lines and a matching blue pen.
items.description: Gold binding rings separate the dark cover-facing page from the clean cream checklist.

items.title: New Ideas for 2027 Lightbulb
items.alt: Gold lightbulb with navy New Ideas for 2027 lettering inside the glass and two green leaves beside its base.
items.description: The large serif year follows three shorter words above the visible glowing filament.

items.title: Team Building a 2027 Bridge
items.alt: Two illustrated office workers positioning gold 2027 blocks across a small stone bridge labeled Building Together.
items.description: A curly-haired woman in navy and a short-haired man in a rust jacket lean toward the numbered arch from opposite sides.

items.title: Launch into 2027 Briefcase
items.alt: Navy business briefcase with a gold rocket clasp beneath a Launch into 2027 ribbon and sweeping upward arrow.
items.description: The full gold arrow curves around the lower case and rises at one side of its stitched flap.

items.title: A New Chapter 2027 Book
items.alt: Open cream-and-gold book with A New Chapter across the pages and large 2027 below the right-hand wording.
items.description: Small blue floral ornaments and a gold ribbon bookmark frame the clear serif message.
